observed_failure.phase: first request validation after successful engine initialization but before generation
observed_failure.error: Requested sample logprobs of 151936, which is greater than max allowed: 20
observed_failure.cause: SamplingParams(logprobs=-1) correctly requests the full vocabulary, but the scorer omitted the matching engine-level max_logprobs=-1 setting and therefore retained vLLM's default API cap of 20.

correction.change: Add max_logprobs=-1 to the vLLM LLM constructor.
correction.meaning: Lift the engine API cap so the already-frozen SamplingParams(logprobs=-1) full-vocabulary request is accepted.

retry_policy: After recording the corrected scorer hash, retry only the unchanged vLLM half on the same pod. Do not rerun the completed Hugging Face half.
